column3: Settled at the back early - urged forward with over 2f left - made smooth progress a furlong out - hit front inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to prevail
Handy up front early - pushed along over 2f out and gained ground inside final furlong - fought for the lead close home - stayed on well but edged out by a half length
Settled around midfield - looked for space 2f out then eased right for room inside final furlong - finished with purpose but too far back to land a blow - third at the line
Sent forward early - lost front spot after a furlong - urged on approaching 2f out - regained command inside final furlong - overtaken close home - unable to find more late
Tracked the front group early - moved up to challenge 3f out - kicked on in front approaching 2f out - overtaken with a furlong to run - eased back through the closing stages to finish fifth

Settled just off the pace early on - pushed along three furlongs out - angled to the near side approaching final two furlongs - unable to find extra response inside the final furlong and finished sixth
tucked up front early - hit the front after a furlong - challenged three out - pushed along and lost command over two out - dropped away final furlong to finish seventh
Settled with the pack early - went wide approaching 3f out then under pressure and toiling 2f out - faded from there to finish eighth
Held up early pulling hard - dropped away 2f out - well held at finish
Held a midfield spot early - urged into contention with 2f left and hit the front inside the final furlong - eased clear for a comfortable win
Just in front early - driven approaching final furlong before losing top spot - stayed on for second without troubling winner
Stumbled at the off - close up behind the front-runner - driven approaching final two furlongs - stayed on but unable to find more late
Held up towards the back - pushed along with a furlong left - finished on inside without getting near leaders
Held up at back - driven with over 2f out - kept battling but couldn't get close enough - finished fifth
Sat close to the pace fighting for control - urged forward with two furlongs left - edged off a straight line and lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled at the back - nudged for effort 2f out - never threatened 7th
Held a midfield spot early - urged forward with over 2f left - lost touch steadily through the closing stages - finished well held in 8th
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward with over 2f left - dropped away feebly - finished 9th
Set the pace from the off - pushed along approaching 2f out - edged left inside the closing furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Settled in a handy spot early - urged forward approaching 2f out - driven up after the front-runner inside the final 2f - stayed on well but unable to reel in the winner
Dwelt at the start - settled at the back - ridden to make progress 3f out - angled right 2f out - picked up ground over 1f out - ran on with purpose inside the final furlong to claim third close home

Settled in the pack early - pushed along approaching final 2f and drifted left but moved into third inside the final furlong - couldn't build on that - edged back out of third close home to finish fourth
Sat behind the front group - asked for effort over 2f out then drifted left and lost ground inside final furlong - finished fifth well beaten
Handy early - driven approaching 2f out - lost ground final furlong and finished well held
Settled at back of field - made no impression through the contest - finished well adrift in 7th
Held up early - drifted left approaching 2f out - unable to challenge - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - lost more ground when pushed along with 2f left - couldn't find any response - well held at the finish
Sat close up on the outside in the early stages - pushed for effort with 2f left - edged off a straight line and lost place inside the final furlong
Settled in the pack early - dropped away under pressure with 3f left - soon well held - finished 11th
Sat behind the pace early - pushed along into 3rd approaching 2f out - moved second a furlong out before edging ahead inside the final furlong - kept going strongly to the line
Sat second early - shared front spot at halfway - driven up front two out - driven again soon after - challenged hard inside final furlong and edged out for narrow defeat

Sat close to the pace early - back in 6th with 2f left - moved into 3rd and cruising with a furlong and a half to run - pushed along and kept responding to the line but couldn't get on terms - finished third

Slow into stride and well off the pace early - settled towards the back - improved on the outside to 6th with 3f left - pushed along into 5th 2f out then 4th entering final furlong - held that spot to finish fourth
Held up towards the back early - pushed along around 2f out then improved into 7th with a furlong left - stayed on late but never in serious contention
Settled midpack early - pressed for effort in 8th with 3f left - stayed on same gear through the closing furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - improved into 5th with 3f left - pushed along but couldn't find more - beaten into 7th
Settled midpack early - pressed for effort in 9th turning for home - unable to close - finished well held in 8th
Set the pace fighting for control early - matched by a rival at the midpoint - pushed along and overtaken 2f out - lost momentum to finish ninth beaten 12¾ lengths
Sluggish start - held up at the back - made no impression - finished well beaten in 10th
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along and slipped back to 7th turning for home - faded from there to finish 11th
Settled midpack early - pushed along in 10th turning for home - unable to close - finished well beaten in 12th
Sluggish getaway - settled towards the back before improving into the pack by halfway - pressed on but faded from 4f out to finish well beaten
Settled around midfield - unable to make headway from 4f out - dropped away late to finish well beaten
Slow to break and dropped well behind - never on terms with rivals - well beaten off the pace throughout - eventually finished last
Sat close to the pace - shifted left approaching final 2f - driven into second inside last furlong - hit the front with a furlong left - drew clear to win comfortably

Settled just behind the pace - hit the front 2f out - came under pressure and had a rival close in with a furlong left - eased ahead but was overtaken close home - unable to find more in the closing stages - finished second beaten 2 lengths
Settled in the pack - asked for effort with 2f left - stayed on without threatening to finish third
Set the pace early - driven to hold advantage before being passed 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished fourth
Held up towards back of pack - driven approaching final furlong - unable to find extra gear - finished 5th
Slow to break - held up towards the back - urged forward with a furlong left - squeezed for room approaching the final stages and unable to make an impression
Sat close to front pack early - urged forward two out - dropped away final furlong to finish seventh
Held up early - dropped away approaching the final furlong - well held at the finish
Settled just off the pace on the inner - made ground into contention over 2f out - closed to press the front approaching the final furlong - driven to the front close home - stayed on strongly to win

Sent forward early to command - kept up the pace until pushed for effort 2f out - driven out inside final two furlongs and put under further pressure - overtaken close home - kept battling to the line - finished second
Restrained in the rear half - gradual progress from 2f out - nudged forward over 1f out - moved into third inside the final furlong - lacked the speed to get to the front two
Settled towards the back early - lost touch approaching 3f out - work needed under pressure 2f out - responded to finish strongly - closed steadily to go down 3.75 lengths in 4th
Settled in a forward spot early - pushed along approaching 2f out - asked for effort inside final 2f - dropped away close home finishing fifth
Sat behind the front group early - asked for effort approaching final 2f but faded quickly inside the last furlong - finished well held in 6th
Held up towards the back - pushed for effort with over 2f left - unable to close - finished seventh
Sprang awkwardly at the off - settled in the pack - asked for effort with over 2f left - moved left approaching final furlongs - faded from there and beaten well home
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - never a factor and beaten home in 9th
Sluggish start - stayed handy early - pressed for effort before fading two out - well held at the finish
Sat close to the front pair in third - urged forward 3f out and again with 2f left - surged clear inside the final furlong - kept finding more to the line
Sat closest to the front-runner early - asked for effort 2f out and joined for command 1 1/2f out - went clear briefly 1f out - overtaken inside the final furlong - held on for second
Settled just behind the front rank in 5th - asked for effort into 4th 2f out - stayed on late to snatch 3rd near the line - finished 3.75 lengths back

Set the pace early - urged on with two furlongs left before being reached approaching the final furlong and a half - overtaken a furlong out - unable to find more late finishing fourth beaten under four lengths
Settled midpack early - pressed for effort inside final 2f in 6th then up to 5th with a furlong left - couldn't find more late finishing fifth
Held up towards the back - still 7th under pressure 2f out - unable to close - finished sixth
Held up towards the back - urged into effort entering the straight - stayed on same gear late to finish 7th
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort turning into straight - slipped back to 7th with a furlong left - unable to threaten late finishing well held
Poor start - stayed towards the back - made no impression - finished well beaten in 9th
Held up at the back - failed to make an impression - finished well behind in 10th
Sat close to the pace early - went to the front inside the final furlong under a shake-up - kept finding more to score with plenty in hand
Sat behind leading duo early - urged forward with 2f remaining - failed to gain ground with a furlong left - moved into second late but couldn't threaten winner
Went straight to front but under pressure from rivals - pushed along and lost command inside final furlong - lost momentum close home to finish third
Hampered start - held up towards the back - urged into action by halfway - kept going without gaining much ground - finished fourth beaten 2.5 lengths
Fought for control early - settled off the pace - began to close ground over 2f out - pushed to the front inside the final furlong - drew away easily to score
Prominent early - tight for room when asked to press on approaching 2f out - found a gap and gained ground into the final furlong to move up to second - unable to overhaul the winner
Pulling hard early - tracked pace close up on rail - travelling strongly two out - pressed for effort a furlong out - edged out inside final furlong but kept battling to the line
Fought for control early - sat behind the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left and made progress inside final 2f - weakened close home finishing fourth
Pulled hard from the off - ran wide in the early stages - struck the front after 2f - driven 2f out and lost the lead over 1f out - weakened through the closing furlong to finish 5th

Sluggish start - settled towards the back - roused into action three out - still much work needed with two to run - angled left and made progress a furlong out - stayed on to finish sixth beaten eight lengths
Handy in the field - pushed forward 2f out but short of room over 1f out - never threatened and finished 7th
Fought for control early - inexperienced and settled at back of field - urged forward passing the 3f marker - drifted left under pressure inside final furlong and finished without threatening
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - unable to land a blow thereafter - well beaten in 9th
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 3f left and found little - held no response to the finish
Set the pace - displaced after 2f - pushed for effort 2f out and briefly squeezed for space 1f out - faded to finish 11th
Held up in the pack - pushed forward with 2f left - shifted left and squeezed for space inside the final furlong then dropped away quickly
Sluggish start - held up at the back throughout - never a threat - well held in 13th
Settled in midfield early - moved into contention and driven forward 2f out - hit the front 1 1/2f out - opened up a big advantage 1f out - powered home for a comfortable success
Up with the front group - short of room 2f out and nudged along into 4th approaching the final furlong - stayed on to take 2nd but never able to challenge for the lead
Sat behind the front group - moved into second two out - pressed on under urging - eased back to third final furlong holding on for the finish
Up with the pace in 2nd and pulling hard early - moved to the front after 2f and quickly built a gap - margin cut and driven 2f out - passed 1 1/2f out and dropped to 4th - no more to give late
Hesitant start - held towards the back - urged forward with two furlongs left - asked for effort a furlong out and stayed on same gait to finish fifth
Sluggish start - held up towards the back - urged forward with a furlong and a half left - moved into 6th inside the final furlong and finished at an even effort - eventually 6th
Set the pace early - fighting for control before being overtaken after two furlongs - eased back to sixth two out under pressure - couldn't find further progress and beaten well into 7th
Poor start and stuck at the rear - still well adrift entering the straight and urged forward - up to 11th with a furlong left - finished 8th holding on well late
Sat close to the front pack - pushed along in 3rd with 2f left - dropped away late to finish 9th
Sat close to pace early - pushed along in 7th with 2f left - unable to close - finished well held in 10th
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left holding 11th - unable to close - finished well held
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along into 10th with two furlongs left before improving to 8th approaching the final furlong - lost ground late to finish well beaten
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - dropped away late to finish 13th
Sluggish start - settled at the back and asked for effort early - lost touch in the straight - finished well adrift in 14th
Held up early - made progress into third with 4f left - shadowed the pacesetter approaching 2f out with driving needed - hit the front inside the final 2f - stayed on strongly to score comfortably
Up with the leading duo - moved to second at halfway - hit the top at 3f out and driven forward - passed and edged left behind the winner below 2f out - faded in the final furlong to finish 2nd
Sat fourth early - faded to the back before halfway - driven hard under two furlongs left - rallied late to overhaul tired others and move into third - never able to reach the leading duo
Slow to break - tracked up front before fading 4f out - couldn't find any extra despite urging - finished 4th
Went straight to front - driven up when overtaken 3f from home - faded rapidly thereafter
Bumped at the break - set the pace throughout - edged right in front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score unopposed
Settled with the pack early - asked for effort 3f out - moved right for room 2f out - climbed to second inside final furlong but held by winner
Settled towards the back showing little urgency - given encouragement 6f out then driven with 4f left - nudged into a bit of progress inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish third
Drifted left at the outset - sat handy early - urged forward approaching 3f out - unable to strike into contention 2f out - dropped away over the final furlong to finish fourth
Drifted right at the off - settled behind the front group - pushed along 3f out and asked for more with 2f left - weakened inside the final furlong to finish fifth
Fought for control early - settled at the rear - stayed off the pace throughout - well held in 6th
Sat behind front group - third with 2f left before being asked for effort - fourth and driven a furlong out - surged through to hit the front inside the final furlong - kept finding more to win
Sluggish start - held up towards the back - improved into 8th under pressure with 2f left - up to 3rd a furlong out then edged into 2nd near the line but not troubling winner

Shared front spot before taking control at halfway - asked for effort approaching 2f out - challenged and drawn level with a furlong and a half left - overtaken inside the last - held on for third close home
Held up towards the back - improved into 7th under pressure 2f out - up to 6th with a furlong left - stayed on late to finish 4th
Sluggish start - settled midfield before edging into 6th and driven 2f out - flattened out for 5th

Shared front spot early - fighting for control - lost command at halfway - urged back into contention 1 12f out - asked for effort soon after - lost place approaching final furlong and unable to fight back late
Sat handy behind the front group - under pressure in 5th with 2f remaining - unable to close final furlong - finished seventh
Held up towards the back - urged forward in 11th with 2f left - unable to close final furlong
Settled in the pack early - driven up in 12th two furlongs out - unable to close the gap - finished ninth beaten six lengths
Settled in the pack - pushed along around 10th with 2f left - unable to close - finished 10th
Held a midfield spot early - pressed for effort 2f out but 11th at that point - unable to close the gap late
Slow to break - settled at the back of the field - made no impression - finished well held in 12th
Sat close to the front group pulling hard - pushed along in 4th with 2f left - faded quickly to finish well held
Sat close to the front pack early - pushed along and slipped back to 9th with 2f left - lost ground steadily to finish well held in 14th
Held up at the rear from the start - remained detached throughout - well held at the finish
Settled close up early - hit the front with over 2f left and edged off a straight line - given a squeeze for effort - kept finding more to the finish - won with plenty in hand
Held up at back - gained ground 3f out to reach third with 2f left - pressed clear leader in the closing stages but couldn't close - held for second
Slow to begin - settled just behind the pace on the rail - lost touch with the front over 3f out despite urging - kept battling to the line - grabbed third close home
Set the pace early - lost the front spot with over 2f remaining and driven to chase it back - stayed competitive before fading close home - eventually finished 4th
Sat behind the front group early - urged forward with over 2f remaining - drifted left and dropped away to finish fifth
Held up at the back - pushed along with 2f left - never able to challenge - finished sixth
Tracked front group on the outside - dropped away 4f out - beaten a long way from 2f out home

Drifted slightly right at the outset - settled handily up with the pace - improved into second spot 2f out - pushed along to close on the front-runner inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly - got up close home to score
Went straight to the front - driven with two furlongs left then urged on with one to go - couldn't quicken again when overtaken close home
Sluggish start before settling handy - pressed for effort with 2f left - faded from contention approaching final furlong - responded to finish well beaten into third
Held up near back - lacked pace with much ground to make up two out - never on terms with front pair but finished well down the inner to take fourth

Settled just behind the front group early after fighting for control - asked for effort with two furlongs left - driven but making no headway a furlong out - dropped away quickly to finish fifth beaten 5 lengths
Held up towards the back - driven for effort more than 2f out - drifted left once headway had gone over 1f out - well held in 6th
Sat behind the front pack early - pushed along approaching 2f out - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish seventh
Settled with the main group early - dropped away with over 2f left - faded late to finish eighth

Sat just off the front pair moving smoothly 3f out - urged forward into second approaching the final stages - found strong late progress to hit the front inside the last - kept driving to the line unchallenged
Settled at the back early - urged into 4th 2f out - fought into 3rd soon after - stayed on to snatch 2nd but not quite catch winner
Sat just behind the front pair early - urged forward into 3rd with 3f left then fought for the lead approaching 2f out - held on in 3rd at the finish
Set the pace early - asked for effort 2f from home and quickly put under serious rivalry - overtaken inside final furlong - dropped to 4th and unable to find more close home
Sat close to pace early - pushed along and slipped to rear 2f out - unable to close - finished 5th
Settled towards the far rail in midfield - improved into contention over a furlong out - pushed along and eased across to the right inside the last - powered clear close home to score

Settled just off the pace on the near flank - moved across left approaching the furlong marker - pushed to the front - stayed on strongly inside the final furlong - caught close home to finish second by a short head
Settled in the pack early on the near rail - made progress two out - pushed along a furlong out and edged right inside the final furlong - finished strongly to be third by half a length
Settled up with the pace on the near rail - pushed along a furlong out to press for the lead - stayed on well through the closing stages - finished fourth beaten just over a length
Set the pace early - drifted off a true line under pressure inside final furlong and lost the advantage - couldn't find more in the last 110yds finishing fifth beaten 3.25 lengths
Settled towards the stands rail in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same gear through the final furlong to finish 6th
Settled handy on the near flank - pressed for effort and edged right approaching the furlong marker - held no more in hand to finish seventh
Moved across to track the far rail early - held a midfield position - crossed back right approaching the final furlong and stayed on at one gear to finish eighth
Settled among the pack early on the near flank - pushed along and moved left inside the final furlong - stayed on at one gear to finish ninth
Settled towards the stand rail close to the pace - pushed along with a furlong left - held no more late on to finish 10th
Sluggish start - settled at the back near the stands rail - pushed along with a furlong left - stayed on at one gait to the line - finished 11th beaten 6½ lengths
Settled towards the stands rail in the pack - pressed for effort and eased across right a furlong out - lost ground inside the last to finish 12th
Settled on the near flank in mid-pack - pushed along with a furlong left - unable to close the gap - finished well held in 13th
Moved across to the near rail early - up with the front pack - pushed along and drifted right 2f out then dropped away late finishing 14th
Settled towards the pace on the near rail - held a central group through the race - pressed for effort a furlong out - weakened quickly to finish well beaten in 15th
Slow to begin - shifted to the near rail and settled at the back - made progress two out - drifted right over a furlong out - unable to find more and finished 16th

Settled towards rear on the wide track - pushed along and drifted left as the front bunch went on over a furlong out - drifted right approaching the furlong marker - then lurched left inside the final furlong - unable to find more and well beaten in 17th
Settled towards the back early - stayed on the near rail - made progress but boxed in approaching final furlong - found little room to finish the effort - stuck on close home to finish 18th
Settled on the near flank in the pack - pushed along with a furlong left - dropped away late to finish well held

Started on the far flank - drifted across to link with rivals after a furlong - stayed within range of the front pack - pushed along and drifted right two furlongs out - allowed to drop away inside the final furlong to finish 20th
Held a spot on the far flank in the early stages - up with the pace - pushed along with two furlongs left - dropped away final furlong to finish well back
Settled towards the back on the far flank early - pushed along and drifted left approaching the final furlong - no impact through the finish
Settled towards one flank in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away soon after and well held at the finish
Settled up on the far flank early - tracked the front group - moved across to the left approaching the final furlong - lost ground soon after and finished well beaten
Settled at the back early - stayed on the outer flank throughout - never able to close - finished well beaten in 25th
Held up towards the back - pushed along and edged right approaching final furlong - weakened close home to finish 26th
Settled towards the far rail early - tracked the front group - pushed along with two out - dropped away over a furlong out and finished well held
Settled towards the far flank early - hit the front of the pack but pressed for effort and lost the advantage inside the final furlong and a half - then dropped away quickly
Settled in the pack early - urged forward approaching 3f out - made smooth progress into contention 2f out - hit the front inside the final furlong - drew clear for an easy success
Sat behind pace - pushed into command over 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left - stayed on but outpaced by winner
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort with 2f left - responded under pressure inside the final furlong - stayed on at one gear to finish third
Settled midfield early - driven into contention over 2f out to share second briefly before weakening close home - finished fourth
Held up towards back of field - driven with three furlongs left and kept trying - unable to close 1f out - finished 5th
Slow to break - held towards the back - driven up to challenge nearer leaders with over a furlong left - lost place close home
Held up towards the back - given a squeeze approaching the final two furlongs - unable to find any extra gear - finished seventh
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 3f left - found nothing - eventually well held in 8th
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost front spot approaching 2f out then drifted right and lost momentum inside the final furlong - allowed to finish in own time well held
Slow to break - settled close up early - pushed along and dropped away steadily over 2f out - finished well beaten in 10th
Settled in midpack early - looked for space around 2f out - moved closer to front markers approaching final furlong - shaken up to hit front inside last - stayed on to win
Settled around midfield - asked for effort with 2f left - moved into contention approaching the final furlong to go second - unable to match the winner's turn of foot late
drifted left at the break - went clear in front - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - lost command approaching final furlong and kept battling to the line
Tucked up with the pack early - pressed for effort and lost touch over 2f out before finding another gear inside the final furlong - stayed on at one tempo to finish 4th
Handy early - closed on pace 2f out and pushed into front approaching final furlong - overtaken soon after - held no more inside final stages
Settled towards the back early - pressed for effort with 2f left but lost ground a furlong out - stayed on steadily inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled among the pack early - pressed for effort with 3f left - lost ground from 2f out to finish seventh
Held up early holding a strong pull - unable to land a blow through the race - finished well beaten in 8th
Settled in the pack early - lost touch and slipped towards the back after 1f - toiling from 2f out - well held at the finish
Settled just behind the front group early - urged into contention over 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished tenth well beaten
Settled in the middle of the pack - urged into contention in 6th with 2f left - moved up to 2nd approaching the final furlong - hit the front close home and powered clear to win
Sat just behind the front pair on rail - urged forward into second 1½f out - battled on in second approaching the final furlong - held for the win by 0.3 lengths
Handy early - shaken up to hit front turning for home - under pressure 2f out - lost lead approaching final furlong and finished without response
Held up towards the back - urged into contention around 12th with 2f left - stronger into 7th approaching the final furlong then finished fourth having made late gains but not menacing the front pair
Held up in the pack - improved into 5th and asked for effort 2f out - stayed on same gear to finish
Sat just behind the front pack early - urged into 2nd two out - dropped to 4th approaching the final furlong - held on without finding more late finishing 6th
Settled midpack early - pressed for effort with 2f left in 8th - unable to close - beaten well home
Settled just off midfield along the rail - pressed for effort in 11th with 2f remaining - stayed on without finding extra to finish 8th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along in 10th with 2f left - unable to close - beaten into 9th
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - unable to threaten in the closing stages
Held up in the pack - pushed along in 9th two out - unable to close - finished 11th
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along in 7th with 2f left - dropped away to finish 12th
Slow to break - settled towards the back of the pack - unable to make headway in the straight and well held
Slow to break - trailed the field throughout - no impact on proceedings - finished well down the field in 14th
Held up at the back from the outset - made no impression through the race - well held at the finish
Sent clear in front early - lost command approaching the straight under pressure - dropped away quickly - allowed to drop away last furlong finishing well adrift
Pulling hard early - sat close to the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on to prevail
Handy early spot - urged forward to challenge 3f out - moved ahead 2f out drifting right - overtaken approaching final furlong - held on at the finish
Fought for a strong grip early - settled towards back - made progress two out - shaping to close entering final furlong - continued at an even effort to finish third
Settled at the back early - improved into midpack by halfway - pushed along with 3f left - closed late but not quite enough for third
Settled in the pack early - pushed along 2f out then boxed in and bumped inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish 5th beaten a length and a half
Fought for control early - settled towards the back - asked for effort with 2f remaining - closed ground approaching the final furlong - stayed on to finish well but just short

Settled with strong grip early - up with the front group - pushed along and closed on the pacesetter 3f out - still in contention 2f out but drifted right - lost momentum inside final furlong to finish seventh
Settled off the pace in the pack - pressed for effort and lost touch approaching final 2f - responded late to finish without threatening

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - up front from the first furlong - held a slim advantage into the straight - pushed along and overtaken 2f from home - knocked about and gave way inside the final furlong - well held in 9th
Went straight to the front - lost the advantage after a furlong then pushed along with the field still to face 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well held
Handy in the pack early - driven to the front inside final two furlongs - asked for effort in the last furlong - held on gamely to score
Settled in the pack early - urged forward and gained ground over 2f out - moved into second soon after - driven inside the final furlong - kept responding to the line but narrowly denied
Sat behind front pack - driven on 2f out and well placed with a furlong left - couldn't find more inside final 110yds finishing third
Slow to break - held up in the pack - urged into effort with 3f left - stayed on to move fourth inside final furlong but found no extra late
Slow to begin - settled towards the back - shaken up to make late gain but couldn't threaten leaders inside final furlong
Sent clear early holding an eager grip - driven and lost front spot nearing 2f out - dropped away to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - urged forward inside the final 3f - showed nothing thereafter - finished well beaten in 7th
Slow to break - held towards the back of the pack - urged forward approaching 3f out then lost ground before the furlong marker
Settled in the pack early - moved into fourth spot with four furlongs left - driven for effort then dropped away with over two furlongs to run - finished ninth
Settled in the pack - pushed along over 2f out - faded into 10th

Settled just behind the front group - short of space with two furlongs left - found space and stayed on strongly - level with rival inside the last furlong - drifted right approaching the final 110 yards - got up close to home
Went straight to front - dictated brisk gallop - driven approaching final furlong - caught close home despite maximum effort

Held up towards the back - began closing gradually from 3f out - shifted across and gained ground with under a furlong left - full of promise entering the final furlong - drifted right approaching the last 110yds and lost momentum close home
Tracked the pace in a forward spot - pushed along a furlong out then lost ground to three rivals - dropped away close to the line finishing fourth
Settled in the pack - urged forward approaching 2f out then lost ground a furlong out - stayed on late to finish 5th
Tracked the pace in second early - urged forward 3f out then dropped away over 1f out - faded quickly through the finish to come home sixth
Sluggish getaway - held towards the back - dropped away approaching the final furlong
